resources.string: Keeps Galaxy Bridge connected to your Mac
Your Galaxy screen is visible on your Mac
The phone camera is available on your Mac
Requests that need confirmation before the phone camera starts
Tap to review and start the camera.
Use your Galaxy camera on Mac
Galaxy Bridge on your Mac requested access to this phone’s camera. The camera starts only after you confirm here.
Lets you use your Mac mouse and keyboard on this phone. Galaxy Bridge does not read passwords or protected content.
Use your Galaxy alongside your Apple Mac
Your Galaxy is connected. Open its screen and apps directly from your Mac.
Find your Mac automatically when both devices use the same Wi-Fi network.
Show Galaxy Bridge status while it is ready or connected.
Let your Mac play audio from this phone while you share the screen.
Allow Galaxy Bridge to follow your mouse, keyboard, and trackpad commands from your Mac.

Galaxy Bridge uses Accessibility only for taps, gestures, navigation, and text that you send from your Mac. It does not read passwords or screen contents, act on its own, or show protected content. You can turn this access off at any time in Settings.
See phone notifications on your Mac, reply, or dismiss them.
Files from your Mac are saved to Download/GalaxyBridge on your phone.
Use your phone camera as Galaxy Bridge Camera on your Mac.
Galaxy Bridge keeps your usual messaging app. You can reply from your Mac when a message notification arrives.
Confirm access to calls already managed by Galaxy Bridge on this phone.
Scan the QR code shown in Galaxy Bridge on your Mac. The scanner opens directly in this app.
Your Galaxy can reconnect to this Mac automatically when both devices are nearby.
Point the camera at the pairing QR from GalaxyBridge on your Mac.
Camera permission is required to scan pairing codes.
This QR code wasn’t recognized. Show a new code on your Mac and try again.
Camera preview for GalaxyBridge QR pairing scanner
This phone and Mac will forget each other. Saved notification and clipboard history will be removed, and active sharing will stop.
Select the features you want to use with your Mac. Your choices are saved on this phone.
Select at least one feature to continue.
Open your phone screen and apps from Galaxy Bridge on your Mac. Start the connection on your Mac.
Play phone audio on your Mac while sharing the screen from your Mac.
Share copied text and web links between your phone and Mac.
No more phone permissions are needed for your choices.
Your choices are saved. Open Galaxy Bridge on your Mac and test the selected features. Keep both devices connected.
This settings page could not be opened. Open Settings on your phone and find Galaxy Bridge.
Your choices could not be saved. Try again.
Show camera requests from your Mac so you can approve them before the camera starts.
Choose one file up to 10 GB. It will be saved to Downloads on your paired Mac.
Pair a Mac before sending files.
The file or saved transfer could not be opened. Check access and free space, then try again.
Waiting for your Mac. The transfer will continue when it reconnects.
